title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical port
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical portrait of a young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, seated indoors in a softly lit bedroom and photographed at intimate smartphone distance. Her ethnicity is left unspecified because race or ethnicity cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has smooth fair skin with a luminous, porcelain-like complexion, a narrow oval-to-heart-shaped face, a delicately tapered jawline, softly sculpted cheeks, a small straight nose, naturally full coral-pink lips, and very large dark brown almond-shaped eyes looking directly into the camera. Her makeup is polished and doll-like, with subtle warm pink eyeshadow, fine black eyeliner, long defined lashes, softly shaped dark brows, delicate rosy blush, and a gentle highlight along the nose and cheekbones. Her expression is calm, poised, and slightly alluring, with relaxed lips and steady eye contact.

Her hair is extremely long, thick, glossy, and deep dark brown to near-black, parted slightly off center with natural lift at the roots. It falls freely over both shoulders, with most of the length cascading down one side of her chest in loose, soft waves. She lightly holds a section of her hair with one hand while the opposite arm extends outward toward the camera or phone, suggesting a seated selfie pose. Small tattoos are visible across the upper chest near the collarbone and on the upper arm, and she wears a delicate gold necklace with a tiny pendant.

She wears exactly a highly cropped white ruched bandeau-style top with a straight gathered neckline, decorated with a large dark navy satin bow centered on the front. Wide dark navy shoulder straps frame the top, while additional dark fabric panels and pale ribbon details run vertically along the sides of her torso. Her midriff remains fully exposed. Below, she wears a fitted dark high-waisted bottom with pale crisscross ribbon lacing across the front.

The background is a contemporary bedroom with a gray upholstered headboard, pale pillows, rumpled patterned bedding, a light wall, vertical beige curtains, and a dark nighttime window. Use warm diffused ambient room lighting mixed with subtle screen-like frontal illumination, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, gentle lens softness, 35mm-equivalent smartphone perspective, cinematic low-contrast color grading, muted beige and charcoal tones, and softly glowing warm highlights. Aspect ratio 9:16.
